neighbours.label: the possessive 's after 'life' ('life's work', 'life's savings')
fire: The museum is a tribute to the painter's life's work.
She lost her life's savings in the collapse of the bank.
Building this school was the greatest of his life's achievements.
The professor spoke about his life's work on coral reefs.
Meeting her was the greatest surprise of my life's long journey.
He considered the novel to be his life's masterpiece.
Many of the inventor's life's accomplishments went unnoticed.
They invested their life's savings in a small bakery.
quiet: The museum is a tribute to the painter's early work.
She lost her father's savings in the collapse of the bank.
Building this school was the greatest of the town's achievements.
The professor spoke about his student's work on coral reefs.
Meeting her was the greatest surprise of the trip's long journey.
He considered the novel to be his brother's masterpiece.
Many of the inventor's best accomplishments went unnoticed.
They invested their parents' savings in a small bakery.

notes: Top 32: '’s' x8 and "'s" x5, the strongest possessive examples are 'her life⟦'s⟧ accomplishments', 'their life⟦'s⟧ work'; the + pole is 'Life of the'. Low max (10.7). Near misses use possessives of other nouns in the same frames.
